reason: Refuted under the value lens: the realistic public gain is about +0.0001..+0.0004, far below the +0.002 bar and ~10x below LB noise (0.003); the idea's own central estimate (+0.0003) already fails the gate. Checked numbers: (a) CONTEXT.md L1511-1517 confirms 1,337 readmitted of 121,777 raw nodes (1.1%) and 513 pruned leaves, >=479 readmitted. (b) The idea mis-describes readmit: exp56 cell 0 sets BIOHUB_READMIT_MIN_SCORE=0.965 = det threshold, so readmitted nodes are ABOVE-threshold peaks that the ILP discarded. The head already refined them before the ILP; readmit re-adds an unrefined int16 copy from the 0.3 dump. Only the gap-fill pool (scores 0.5-0.965) is really sub-threshold, and there the V1284 head is out of distribution (it was trained and validated on kept peaks at 0.965 or above; GT distance 1.70->1.54 um was measured only on kept peaks, experiments/coordhead_retrain/out_full_P/report.txt). (c) The head does not change matching: in the same report, the share of pairs within 4 um is 0.9390 unrefined vs 0.9387 with the public head, so at the 7 um match radius localisation alone earns ~0. Its +0.007 on x138 comes only from post-ILP geometry (flow prior, 7 um tight gate). Scaling +0.007 by the 1.1% readmit share gives ~+0.0001; x2-3 for sitting at track breaks gives <= +0.0003; gap-fill (share unknown, cap 3%, OOD head) adds <= +0.0002 with sign uncertain. (d) Change (2) (neutral prob): cost = motion + raw_cost*raw - 1.0*prob (cell 5 L651), learned_edge_probs built only from post-ILP edges (L1931-1942). Giving readmit pairs a median ~0.8 bonus reorders only the ~1% of relink decisions near readmitted nodes, with either sign (readmitted peaks were ILP rejects, often duplicates). This is the kind of confidence-lean the lab over-states (edge filter: lab +0.01, LB 0). (e) Change (3): leaf prune is +0.0006 on exp39 in the lab (CI +0.0004..+0.0009), so its ceiling is below the gate even if it transferred fully. Transfer: (1) is geometry-only and would transfer as well as the head does (the head's LB +0.007 on x138 is real), but its absolute size is ~1e-4. Private: same node shares, so a similar ~1e-4 order; denser private embryos could raise the readmit share by a factor of 1-2 (guess), still < +0.0005. Nothing here is measurable on public or private.
fix_if_any: Nothing makes it reach +0.002. The cheapest correct version, as a free rider only: (1) keep readmit as is but give readmitted peaks their pre-ILP head-refined float coordinates. Either run _v1284_refine on _low (for peaks >= 0.965 it reproduces the refined coords exactly: same pooled peaks, same features) or, better, restrict the refine to the >= 0.965 part of the pool and leave the 0.5-0.965 gap-fill peaks unrefined, where the head is out of distribution. Order the patch after the V1284 import and keep ENABLE=0 byte-identical. (2) Instead of a median probability, look up the real pre-ILP network probability of the readmitted node (map it back to its pre-ILP index through the candidate-edge cache); fall back to 0 when none. Lab-gate it at >= +0.0005 with no embryo negative. Never spend an LB slot on it, and do not count it toward the 0.99 plan; include it only if the kernel is being rebuilt anyway for H1/H3 and the dummy-test counts (readmitted within +-10%, no REPAIR FAILED) hold.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0000 to +0.0004 (central +0.0001); indistinguishable from LB noise 0.003; sign of changes (2)/(3) uncertain
realistic_private_gain: +0.0000 to +0.0005 (central +0.0001); geometry part (1) transfers, confidence part (2) may not
critical_path: Only as a rider. Agent container: re-anchored refine patch + tests, ~1.5 h on 25-26 Sep. kaggle-vitalii: dummy-test run inside the H1/H3 bundle after the 26 Sep 00:00 UTC GPU reset (~0.6 GPU-h, shared). Submit with the bundle on 26-27 Sep, scored 7-10 h later, well before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC. Its own contribution will never be identifiable on the LB (needs ~+0.003 to see; ceiling ~+0.0005). A standalone probe is not worth a slot.
